metadata.name: Enhanced Web App to API to DB
metadata.description: An enhanced architecture showing a web application interacting with a highly available and secure API layer, which connects to a resilient database, all under comprehensive monitoring.

properties.description: User-facing web application for interacting with the system, designed for high availability.
Distributes incoming web application traffic across multiple API Gateway instances to ensure high availability and mitigate single points of failure.
Centralized API layer handling requests, routing them to the database, and enforcing robust authentication and authorization mechanisms to secure data access.
Stores all application data, accessed by the API layer, with a clear strategy for backup, recovery, and replication to ensure data resilience.
Provides comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting for all components to proactively identify and address performance or availability issues.
Manages automated backups, recovery processes, and replication for the primary database to ensure data durability and disaster recovery capabilities.
